header.title: Plans & Pricing
header.subtitle: Every feature on every plan, one seat. Credits are only spent on AI phone minutes and video — the CRM, texting, Ask Max, reports and social posting are all included.
header.trial: Start free — no card, no expiry. Every plan includes every feature; only the credit allowance changes.

plans.heading: Monthly plans
plans.help: Pick the plan that matches how much calling and video you do. Change or cancel any time.

blurb.free: Every feature, one seat. Enough to try the AI receptionist.
blurb.solo: Every feature, one seat. For steady solo marketing.
blurb.pro: Every feature, one seat. For daily calling and regular video.
blurb.premium: Every feature, one seat. For high-volume calling and video.
blurb.signature: Everything in Premium, plus a specialist who sets it all up with you.

plans.welcomeGrant: Plus {{credits}} bonus credits when you sign up.

packs.heading: Top-up packs
packs.help: Run out mid-month? Buy more credits without changing your plan. Credits from a pack don't expire.

costs.heading: What actually costs credits
costs.help: Only these. Everything else in CloseBoss is included in your plan.
costs.free: CRM and contacts · texting and email · Ask Max · CMAs and market reports · social images and posting · voice cloning

included.heading: Every plan includes everything
included.help: Plans differ only by how many credits you get. No feature is locked behind a higher tier, and every plan is one seat.
